steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Create the basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files for the web application.

steps.title: Configure HTML Document
steps.description: Set up the basic HTML5 structure, including title, meta tags, and linking stylesheets and scripts. Integrate Tailwind CSS CDN.

steps.title: Design Clock UI in HTML
steps.description: Add a container element in index.html to display the current time.

steps.title: Apply Base Styling with Tailwind CSS
steps.description: Use Tailwind CSS classes to center the clock and set basic font styles in index.html.

steps.title: Implement Time Logic in JavaScript
steps.description: Write JavaScript function to get the current time and format it.

steps.title: Update Clock Display
steps.description: Create a JavaScript function to update the HTML element with the current formatted time.

steps.title: Automate Time Update
steps.description: Set up a JavaScript interval to call the update function every second, ensuring the clock is always live.

steps.title: Read App Metadata
steps.description: Include JavaScript code to read the app_id from app-meta.json, even if not immediately used for a clock app, to maintain project consistency.

steps.title: Finalize Stylesheet (if needed)
steps.description: Add any additional custom CSS to style the clock beyond what Tailwind CSS provides, if desired.

steps.title: Building simpleclock
steps.description: The simple clock web application is now complete and ready for use.
